mainEntity.name: How do I book photography tuition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact Alan to discuss your goals, current skill level, and preferred format. Many people start with a private lesson, then move into a course series or workshops depending on what they want to learn.

mainEntity.name: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact Alan as early as possible if you need to reschedule. Policies vary by format and availability.

mainEntity.name: Do I need any specific skill level to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: No prerequisites are required. Complete beginners are welcome. Sessions can be matched to your current ability and equipment.

mainEntity.name: Can I spread the cost of tuition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Flexible payment plans can be used for selected options. You can also combine formats into a personalised plan.

mainEntity.name: How long until I see improvement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many students notice measurable improvement within the first few sessions when they receive specific, actionable feedback. Progress depends on practice between sessions.

mainEntity.name: What’s included in the four-session bundle?

acceptedAnswer.text: The bundle includes four private sessions for the price of three, scheduled to fit your availability. Content is fully customisable to your needs (camera settings, composition, editing, or a mix).

mainEntity.name: Is online tuition as effective as in-person lessons?

acceptedAnswer.text: Online tuition works very well for editing instruction, image review, and technical concepts using screen sharing. In-person tuition is ideal for hands-on camera operation practice and location shooting scenarios.

mainEntity.name: Can you help with accreditation pathways?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. See RPS mentoring and distinctions support for structured guidance on portfolio development, assessment criteria, and preparation.
